facts.text: John described the experience of being in nature as a way to restart his mind and spirit, emphasizing the peace and beauty of the moment.

evidence.quote: Yeah, it was like restarting my mind and spirit. It's amazing how peaceful and pretty it can be.

facts.text: John mentioned that being in nature helped him remember the little things in life and savor peaceful moments.

evidence.quote: It made me remember the little things in life and savor the peaceful moments.
